# Our investments 

The Church Commissioners manages the Church of England's £11.6 billion endowment fund. We hold a diversified portfolio across public and private equities, property and other real assets, and alternatives such as infrastructure and credit, consistent with our ethical guidelines.

## How we invest

How the Church Commissioners manages the the Church of England's endowment fund

Download fact sheet

We are committed to responsible investment. We think that taking account of environmental, social and governance issues is an intrinsic part of being a good long-term investor, and we engage directly with the companies and tenants we invest in.

## Performance

Our investment objective is to achieve a total return of CPIH plus 4 per cent a year over the long term, so that we can support the work and mission of the Church of England today and for future generations. Over the last 30 years the fund has achieved an average annual return of 9.2 per cent, and we have matched or exceeded our objective over 1, 5, 10 and 30 years.

More detail on our performance, and on how the fund is allocated across asset classes, can be found in our Annual Report.
